system.description:
ESSENCE KETHRANI

The Testament does not pronounce guilt, but once judgement is invoked it demands consequence.
Whenever you successfully Demoralise a creature, the first time you inflict HP damage upon that creature before the end of your next turn, you inflict an additional 1d6 secondary Essence damage.
This additional damage can occur only once from each successful use of Demoralise.

Prerequisites Korath heritage

Use after a successful Demoralise (target the creature): a strike rider — your first damaging Strike against it before the end of your next turn adds +1d6 Essence (added to the damage roll automatically).
